title: Rev2.5.3 ECC Clear Cognitive Prompt

compatibility.policy: Rev2.5.3 changes prompt wording, observability and public documentation only. The persisted AgentSession schema remains 2.7.5-r2.5.2-ecc and the pending continuation schema remains 9-ecc.

architecture.main: Sole semantic authority. Chooses ECC action, objective_state meaning/evolution, and all semantic Memory Graph content/relations/disposition.
architecture.runtime: Non-semantic mechanical authority: schemas, budgets, Evidence, IDs, persistence, objective-state storage, revisions, anchors/freshness, graph topology, permissions, confirmation, transactions, rollback and deterministic execution. It never interprets objective status or gates completion.
architecture.capability_body: Providers are replaceable deterministic bodies. Core has no desktop/robot/network/workspace domain branch.
architecture.world_scope: Host supplies opaque core_memory.world_scope_id; Core hashes it into world:* without interpreting filesystem/device/network semantics.
architecture.memory: Persistent internal graph transversal to all three ECC moves; not a capability or fourth action. Each move declares focus, disposition and semantic operations.
architecture.memory_disposition: unchanged means Main judged persistent understanding unchanged and operations are empty; updated means Main judged a semantic model change and supplies graph operations.
architecture.memory_freshness: Provider-owned Material anchors retain opaque locator, version/hash, freshness token and freshness_arguments. Changed reality degrades affected anchors without deleting semantic memory.
architecture.memory_topology: Runtime exposes only mechanical graph structure/retrieval signals; it never assigns semantic importance, dead-code status, architectural role or relevance.
architecture.memory_retention: Main may keep anything that can plausibly help later, without waiting for an explicit remember command; it stores compact meaning rather than raw observations.
architecture.memory_retrieval: Before every ECC decision Runtime retrieves a bounded world+user graph view from current_request/focus, lexical/tag matches, graph neighborhood and topology fallback.
architecture.evidence: Every physical Material automatically becomes active-session Evidence. Narrow provider selectors may create additional exact spans. Persistent Memory remains a separate LLM semantic choice.
architecture.selectors: Memory Material support uses an optional opaque selector object validated by the originating provider evidence_selector hook.
architecture.freshness_arguments: Providers own the opaque arguments required to recompute source tokens; Runtime persists and replays them without domain interpretation.
architecture.explorar: Observe or non-persistently execute through attached providers.
architecture.construir: Request persistent world changes through attached deterministic providers and Runtime safeguards.
architecture.concluir: Terminal response chosen by Main; Runtime does not inspect objective status as a completion gate. Objective and memory cognition may accompany Concluir without creating phases.
architecture.context_separation: current_request, objective_state, conversation_background, memory_graph, exploration_map, latest_observations/Evidence and runtime_feedback remain distinct.
architecture.provider_boundary: Bundled Standard is only one Host body; alternative products can attach other providers without changing Core/Memory.
architecture.frontier_boundary: Continuation mechanics remain provider/runtime-internal and are not a public ECC cognition primitive.
architecture.transport_cost_safety: Provider/adaptor timeout and structured failure cost protections from Rev2.2+ remain fail-closed.
architecture.objective_state: Transient LLM-owned semantic state separate from canonical current_request. It may be null, replaced or cleared; compound goals may contain bounded semantic children/constraints/outcomes, never execution steps or Runtime planning.
architecture.request_identity: current_request is the immutable canonical user input for the AgentSession. Objective State is an interpretation of what remains to be achieved, not a rewrite of that input.
architecture.benchmark_background_ablation: Diagnostic-only env switch EYLE_BENCHMARK_SUPPRESS_CONVERSATION_BACKGROUND suppresses prompt projection of conversation_background without deleting stored history or changing Memory, Objective, ECC, capabilities, or provider cache behavior.
architecture.prompt_style: Simple direct language: understand intent and implications, remember reusable knowledge without waiting for explicit commands, keep freshness separate from semantic correctness, and require enough support before broad negative claims.

removed: line_start/line_end as universal Memory support selector
memory sidecar with implicit empty/updated meaning
Evidence creation conditional on Memory anchoring

contracts.benchmark_clean_transcript: Authenticated Web DELETE /conversa clears only conversation transcript/pending confirmation when no job is active; persistent core_memory.sqlite3 Memory Graph is preserved.
